accounting.rounding: Checked U256 floor/ceil and exact earned numerator carry
accounting.maturity: First authenticated timely sample at or after maturity, frozen once
accounting.inverseRelativeCeilingError: strictly less than 1e-19 across the supported interval
accounting.issuance: floor(actual underlying * rewardScale / inverseIndex); preview retains original-rate notional and exact difference
accounting.ordinaryTransfer: settle both; earned integer and fractional reward stays with original holder
accounting.recovery: explicit issuer-authorized exact proportional complete earned numerator; full transfer moves exact remainder
accounting.cost: O(1) account storage and arithmetic; no issuance lot/history scan

market.yieldFee: Original Manager charges no new yield fee
